findings.summary: the per-draw visibility guard was transcribed at seven sites across the two PALs with three comment wordings, and every reviewer converged on one shared predicate; applying the doc half of that finding surfaced the deeper defect — docs/fidelity.md and the regression-mesh-flags golden gate the pin's bare-write deferral, which per-draw testing breaks — so the whole mechanism was replaced by the pin's own visibility epoch (set_mesh_visible bumps engine.visibility_epoch only when the cascade changed a flag; both backends re-run only the draw-list build on it; append_draw keeps filtering at build) and the seven guards were removed rather than factored

the identity rule was enforced in the method arm only while compileArgument's sink is shared; the free-function arm gains the same per-call decline (with null/undefined always qualifying and a mutable by-reference struct mismatch declining to the inliner instead of hard-failing), its mirror test, and a sink-branch comment naming the hazard; the qualification probe reorders anonymous-record interning, which renumbers platformer's Record types byte-wise while leaving it identical modulo numbering

storeAtomically is a third copy of the temp-file-plus-rename idiom; kept as a local copy per repo norms (each copy's same-bytes argument is local, and the two stores differ in failure shape), but the store-back became non-fatal like the bake cache's and the equivalence comment is scoped to the rename race
append_draw's engine parameter was dead after the per-draw filter removal; the epoch rework restores the filter, so the parameter is live again and the flagged state no longer exists
sort_transparent_draws paid distance math for hidden meshes while the per-draw design kept them in the lists; the epoch rework filters them out at build, so the flagged waste no longer exists
the addressability qualify blocks carried a dead argument ternary in the method arm (arguments are proven present forty lines earlier); collapsed with a non-null assertion
the inline-path test's second assertion (no make_shared inside a Manager_step call) was vacuous — every emitted call is bblscene-qualified, so the first assertion already forbids it; dropped

setup-worktree.ps1: the optional vcpkg junction appended before the -Remove branch produced a benign duplicate on -SharedVcpkg -Remove (moved below it), two Test-Path guards were redundant with New-Item -Force (collapsed), and the header now states that -Branch composes with -Commit

stale maps orphaned by the first fix: the mesh_draws declaration comment, both depth-task comments, the Dawn uniform-sync soundness argument, and the docs/fidelity.md visibility passage — all restored to the epoch reality, with the passage's 'setMeshVisible is not reached yet' updated to the wired design

the duplicate engine.meshes record load inside the new per-draw guards, and the hidden-mesh uniform writes the guards implied for Dawn's two geometry-task write loops, were both artifacts of the per-draw design; the epoch rework removes the guards and keeps hidden meshes out of every list those loops walk, so neither cost exists
